name: Qatar

income_tax.summary: Qatar taxes no employment income of individuals (salaries, wages and allowances are not taxed regardless of residence). The system is territorial: a self-employed individual may owe income tax on qualifying Qatar-source income, and the PwC page states no personal rates. Social insurance is mandatory for Qatari employees only.
income_tax.self_employed_notes: Self-employed individuals may be taxed on Qatar-source business income (PwC states no rates; corporate-style 10% applies to foreign-owned profits per the existing jurisdiction file). Foreign-source income from foreign clients is outside the territorial charge. Social insurance applies to Qatari nationals only.

open_questions: Tax on a self-employed individual's Qatar-source income: rate and procedure not stated on the PwC page.
Expat employee social security: PwC says only that employers pay social insurance for Qatari employees; no expat contribution found.
PwC other-taxes page re-opened 2026-10-15: it says only that employers pay social insurance for Qatari employees; no expat or self-employed contribution is listed, so 0 is a reading of silence.

rent_1bed_monthly.description: Midpoint of the Qatar Living July 2026 West Bay range for a 1-bedroom (QAR 7,000-9,500). The Pearl/Lusail range is 7,000-10,000. Numbeo city-centre 1-bedroom is QAR 6,914.

rent_2bed_monthly.description: Midpoint of the Qatar Living July 2026 West Bay range for a 2-bedroom (QAR 9,500-13,000). The Pearl/Lusail range is 10,000-16,000. Listing-based typical ranges, not a measured median.

costs.notes: Rents are advertised/estimated, not signed-lease medians, unless stated.

residence_routes: EU, US and other citizens: no visa-free right to work or settle. Skilled employees are normally recruited by a Qatari employer, which arranges the work permit and residence; no dedicated remote-work or digital-nomad visa was found. Residence for property buyers (QAR 3.65 million and above in designated areas) is described in the existing jurisdiction file.
open_questions: No digital-nomad visa found; not confirmed from an official Qatari source.
Employer-sponsored residence process not re-verified from an official page.
